name: Caelrun
tagline: Lakeside fishing village that feeds the Marches, and does not ask who lets it.

population.mix: Mostly fisherfolk; barley farmers along the shore; fringe camps at the bog edge.

ruler: No lord. The great families rule in practice: the Hallans (the fleet) and the Tarnes (the grain).
strangers: Welcome for trade; watched near the swamp edge.

far: the lake flat and grey beyond the barley
leaving: fish smell in your clothes for days
the reed beds closing behind the road

dusk: boats coming in low with the catch

night: something moving out in the reeds

winter: eel traps set under the ice
summer: old temple columns showing in the shallows in drought

situations.name: Tilanda
descriptors: Brother Kellis's cairns hung with ribbons

situations.name: Thuldar
descriptors: funeral chants from the Thulda shrine

itself.title: Food for the Marches
itself.text: Fish, eels, and barley from Caelrun feed the other Marches villages. Dried and smoked fish, fish oil, rush mats, and lake-hemp rope go out along the road.

itself.title: By lizard-man sufferance
itself.text: The village exists because the lizard-men allow it. Most residents believe their prosperity comes from hard work and a good location. A few families, the Hallans and the Tarnes among them, know the truth and keep the unspoken compact.

itself.title: Ruins under the lake
itself.text: Pre-Silence temple foundations lie in the northern depths of the lake. The Aurka have been diving there, and the attention worries those who keep the compact.

day: **Essa the net-mender** offers a piece of gossip, and wants one back.
Two fishing families shout over a contested stretch of shore.
**Tovar the boatwright** berates an apprentice over a badly fitted plank.
A cart of smoked fish loses a wheel on the road.
**1d3 Aurka** come ashore wet, carrying something wrapped in sacking.
A funeral procession walks to the Thulda shrine, chanting.
night: **Kelvan Bresul**, drunk, tells a war story at the Waterside Tavern.
A boat slips out without lanterns toward the southern channels.
**Yavra Quickwater** waits at the far jetty for a passenger.
A fire breaks out in a fish-oil rendering shed.
Lights move in the reeds where no one fishes, and by morning there is nothing.
Leech-gatherers from the bog edge come in to drink and are turned away.

response.watch: About 20 ceremonial militia under Kelvan Bresul, for disputes and drunk fishers.
response.arrival_night: 1d3 militia within 1d4 turns, if Kelvan can be roused.
response.reinforcements: A handful of old veterans, if anyone thinks to call them.
response.strength: Ceremonial. The real protection is the lizard-men, and almost no one knows it.

locations.name: Fish Market
locations.look: Open stalls on the shore where the catch is sold each morning.

labels.days: Every morning; busiest after the autumn eel runs.

locations.name: Waterside Tavern
locations.look: The village tavern, on the water and loud every night.

labels.guests: Fishers, militia, and their drinking captain.
labels.trouble: Fishing-rights quarrels spill out onto the jetty.

locations.name: Tovar's Boatyard
locations.look: Sawdust, pitch, and hulls on trestles.

labels.wares: Fishing boats built to last decades.
labels.proprietor: Tovar the boatwright, who will not be rushed.

locations.name: Net-Menders' Guild
locations.look: The rope-walk and the net-menders' hall.

labels.services: Nets and lake-hemp rope of good quality.

locations.name: Shrine of Thulda
locations.look: A small grey shrine where the dead are prepared.

labels.populace: Mourners, and Mother Hildreth spinning wool by the door.

locations.name: Hallan Compound
locations.look: The fleet master's family compound by the main jetty.

labels.inhabitants: Brecht Hallan, about 40 kin, and servants under Penna.

locations.name: Main Jetty
locations.look: The boat landing at the heart of the village.

labels.passage: To Nebruz: 6 miles south by boat through the swamp channels, then 3 miles on foot. Yavra Quickwater ferries, for a price and no questions.

locations.name: Brother Kellis's Cairns
locations.look: A reed hut on the far shore, and stone cairns marking the safe water paths.

labels.custom: Travellers leave offerings at the cairns before crossing.

factions.scheme: Diving the submerged temple foundations in the lake.

trouble: Aurka activity drawing unwanted attention to ruins
Unspoken lizard-man control - acknowledged by few, ignored by most
Fringe workers (leech gatherers, bog-edge camps) operate outside village authority

neighbors.notes: 6 miles by boat through the swamp channels, then 3 miles on foot through lizard-man swamp.

defenses.militia: Ceremonial, mostly for disputes and drunk fishers
defenses.reality: Lizard-men enforce territorial boundaries from shadows
defenses.village_understanding: Most residents believe their prosperity comes from hard work and good location, unaware of the arrangement

trade_focus: Food surplus provider - feeds other Marches villages

legacy_rumours: Aurka found carved stones in submerged temple foundations
Nebruz smugglers use secret lake channels at night
Old temple columns visible in shallows during summer droughts
